_readme: Template for the PER-CHAT opencode config. The session manager renders
this into each chat volume at <chat>/home/.config/opencode/opencode.json
(where opencode finds it via $HOME), applying per-chat overrides:
- `model` is replaced when the chat was created with an explicit model
- `permission.bash.'git push*'` becomes "allow" only when the repo's
allowlist entry sets "allow_push": true (default is ask — the push
permission request pops in the app; docs/code-agents.md)
Zen models authenticate via the auth.json the manager seeds from
OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY; Together via the TOGETHER_API_KEY env var below.
share is disabled: /share would post transcripts to the public share
`instructions` names config/code-agents/AGENTS.md by the path the manager
renders it to inside the chat volume ($HOME is /chat/home). Absolute, not
relative: opencode resolves relative entries against the PROJECT dir, and
these instructions are the container's, not any one repo's.
